findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：公司可能面臨客戶內部自行開發產品的競爭，且未來銷售前景取決於客戶接受第三方供應來源取代自製；客戶可能增加自製元件使用。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: We may face competition from customers developing products internally. Our customers generally have substantial technological capabilities and financial resources. Some customers have traditionally used, and continue to use, these resources to develop their own products internally.

findings.claim: 10-K 載明公司與 OEM/ODM 客戶無採購承諾，即使取得 design win 也不保證客戶持續採用其 IC。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: we do not have purchase commitments from these customers. Therefore, there can be no assurance that the OEMs and ODMs will continue to incorporate our ICs into their products, even if we may have secured a design win with them.

findings.claim: 搜尋彙總（聚合站）稱無其他直接客戶單一年度占營收超過 10%；未點名最大客戶，亦未見 2026 年第二供應商或自製的具體事件。
findings.source: Web 搜尋摘要（聚合站，未讀頁面）

findings.claim: Edgewater 稱 MPWR VRM 效能問題可能大幅限縮或消除其 Nvidia Blackwell 配額，Renesas 與 Infineon 被視為取得 B200/GB200 配額。
findings.source: TipRanks/The Fly: Monolithic Power slides as Edgewater says allocation in Blackwell at risk

note: 未找到 2026 年最大客戶導入第二供應商或自製的具名報導。搜尋摘要提到 Edgewater 分析師曾稱 Nvidia Blackwell 配額風險（Renesas、Infineon 取得配額），為單一分析師說法、日期不明，列為線索待核。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
